summary: Kidoz Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing plans to report its 2025 annual results on April 29, 2026, and provide a business update via webcast. The filing also discloses an equity incentive update, noting 3,726,000 stock option grants expired unexercised in fiscal 2025, and plans to issue up to 910,000 new stock options to staff and consultants at an exercise price of CAD$0.01 above market close. No options are awarded to directors or officers. The filing is a routine business update and compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
